title: The derived tensor functor with a complex induces maps on derived Hom and on Ext
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-upgrade-tensor-with-complex-derived at source lines 6202-6224: for a site with a sheaf of commutative R-algebras O and a complex K^bullet of O-modules, the derived tensor functor of the earlier lemma induces a canonical map from the derived Hom over the endomorphism dg algebra E = RHom(K^bullet,K^bullet) to the derived Hom over O, which on cohomology is the map of Ext groups induced by the functor. The proof at source lines 6226-6274 has to identify the two sides (the global derived Hom of the Cohomology on Sites chapter on the right, the chapter's own derived Hom realised as a restriction bimodule on the left), reduce to dg modules with property (P) so that the derived tensor product is computed by the ordinary one, obtain a map of complexes of R-modules out of the dg Hom categories, and compose it with the canonical comparison map from a dg Hom into the global derived Hom. It is bookkeeping rather than depth, but the two identifications are exactly what makes the statement non-obvious.
